judgment.defect_reason: The supplied request ties local conversion costs to 150,000 packs annually, while the operative approved record establishes 110,000 packs without establishing revised conversion costs. The rubric assumes those costs apply at 110,000 packs. This leaves the definitive cost basis unresolved. The submission appropriately treats the resulting savings as indicative and requires repricing before commitment.
judgment.rationale: The proposal correctly uses the approved 110,000-pack annual volume and 550,000-pack five-year total. Its calculations are correct: unchanged costs of INR 705,500 per pack, local cost of INR 726,090, unit savings of INR 103,910, annual savings of INR 11,430,100,000 and five-year savings of INR 57,150,500,000. It includes the required ownership, technical and operational responsibilities, sourcing model, localisation roadmap, benefits, risks and actionable approval gates. It distinguishes gross operating savings from investment returns, preserves imported-content forex risk and does not claim assembly alone establishes full localisation or incentive eligibility. No substantive repair is required for its stated purpose as a conditional CPO proposal.
